procedure:
Skin Medica Vitalize Peel
Chemical: Skin Medica Vitalize Peel
Area treated: Face
Discussed diagnosis, alternative treatment, risks and benefits of each treatment. Side effects discussed included but is not limited to erythema, edema, infection, delayed healing, pain, burning sensation, pigment problems, blisters, scarring, keloids, allergic reactions, recurrence of problems and worsening and/or no treatment effects of current skin condition. A written consent was obtained from the patient after explanation. Area to be treated was prepared using Step 1: Prepping Solution. A total of three passes were applied. Using a gauze applicator, a layer of Step 2: Vitalize Peeling Solution was applied equally on treatment area. A total of three passes were applied. Using a gauze applicator, a layer of Step 3: Vitalize Retinol Solution was applied equally on treatment area. A total of three passes were applied. Skin Medica TNS Ceramide Treatment Cream + Skin Medica Essential Defense SPF 35 was applied to conclude treatment. Patient instructed to wash treated area off with gentle cleanser in 4-6 hours. The patient tolerated the procedure well.
